THE DISCRIMINATING CELL of this census so far. Alone among the instruments in the comparative frame, this pool is compulsory. It poses the framework a question rather than illustrating it: if pooling raises each participant's time-average growth rate, why must it be enforced, and why did merchants defect? The available answer is that convoy protection is non-excludable, so private and pooled optima diverge - but it has to be given, not assumed.

THE STRUCTURAL POINT. The pooled object is protection, not indemnity: contributors bought an armed escort, a non-excludable good, and no shipper ever drew on the fund. This is why the pool had to be compulsory (MB3) - non-excludability makes the private and pooled optima diverge - and it is the cell that distinguishes this form from every distributive pool in the census.
